item.title: Roxborough High School defaced with racist graffiti, including swastikas
item.description: Roxborough High School was defaced with racist graffiti, including swastikas, on Saturday night, according to state Rep. Tarik Khan, who posted about the incident on social media Sunday afternoon.

item.title: South Jersey native and Brewers prospect Frank Cairone hospitalized after serious car accident

item.title: Camden homicides hit lowest level since 1985 as violent crime continues to fall
item.description: Homicides and violent crime in Camden fell again in 2025, with city officials saying the latest numbers mark the safest year the city has seen in decades.The Camden County Police Department reported 12 homicides in 2025, down from 17 in 2024, which is a 29% reduction.
